Use case: full-screen portrait backdrop for a card-duel field on a phone.
Subject: a city street crossroads at night seen from almost directly above. Cracked dark asphalt with fine aggregate texture, tar-sealed crack lines, a round manhole cover, faded crosswalk stripes running across the very top edge and the very bottom edge, a concrete curb and sidewalk corner in the top-right with the base of a sodium streetlamp pole, faint spray-paint graffiti tags on the curb at the left and right edges only.
Lighting: one warm amber sodium-lamp pool of light centred slightly above the middle of the image, falling off into deep teal-blue shadows toward all edges.
Style: painted 2D anime card-game background, soft brush texture, matches the reference palette (charcoal asphalt, amber light, teal shadows).
Usage contract: the central 80% of width and the area from 12% to 88% of height must stay calm, plain asphalt with only subtle cracks — game code draws chalk zones, cards and monsters there. Shown as-is, not tiled.
Avoid: chalk lines, rectangles, cards, characters, monsters, cars, people, text, logos, UI, letters in the graffiti that read as words.

Use case: the back of a trading card, shown on every face-down card in a card-duel game, from 40px to 300px wide.
Subject: an original card-back design filling the whole canvas edge to edge: deep crimson field with a thin bright gold outer border and a second inset gold line, a central gold oval medallion containing a stylised eight-point compass star over a swirling dark-red vortex, small gold corner ornaments.
Style: glossy painted trading-card finish, subtle embossed gold, rich reds, symmetrical, reads clearly when tiny.
Avoid: any text, logos, letters, brand marks, eyes, faces, transparent margins.

Use case: bust portraits of the game's opponent, an original street card-duelist character, shown in a small square HUD badge (64-120px) so the face must read when small.
Character (same person in every cell): a lanky teenage street duelist with messy sandy-brown hair under a backwards red cap, freckles, a sharp grin with one chipped tooth, a dark-teal hooded jacket with an amber stripe over a white tee, a card-deck holster strap on the shoulder.
Parts: confident = cocky smirk, eyebrow raised, holding one card up beside his face; rattled = wide eyes, sweat drop, teeth gritted, leaning back; fired_up = shouting with a fist raised, eyes blazing, cap pushed back; defeated = head bowed, eyes shut, cap pulled down, small sad frown.
Style: 2D anime card-game illustration, clean dark outlines, cel shading, warm amber rim light from the right and teal shadow on the left, matching the reference palette.
Composition: one centred head-and-shoulders bust per cell, same head size and shoulder line in every cell, facing the viewer.
Avoid: text, speech bubbles, background scenery, any existing anime character's likeness, blond spiky hair, green jacket.
